# THE ONE LIST of the corpus programs the checker accepts, and what a green `lake build`
# says about each (generated by `crates/gabbro-check/tests/zertifikate.rs`; rewrite it with
# `GABBRO_ZERTIFIKATE=schreiben cargo test --test zertifikate` -- do not edit by hand).
# Cited by `grammatik/Grammatik/Zielsatz/Spec.lean` ("WHAT A GREEN BUILD COVERS").
#
# Population: every `.gab` under `beispiele/` and `beispiele/gift/` with no checker error.
#
# CERTIFIED <program> <module> <chain>
#   The exporter carries the program to an `Einheit` (`gE`), and <module> -- the byte-exact
#   output of `gabbro obligations --g <program>`, in the build -- decides the checker premise
#   of the goal theorem on it (`gCheck`, `by decide`) and instantiates the goal theorem
#   (`gP_gabbro`: `Ziel` on every run of machine G, the user's duty `NutzerPflicht gE` as the
#   hypothesis). What the export drops is named in the module's own header ("NO FORM in G").
#   <chain> is `chain-instance=<name>` when a Lean instance of the generic closing theorem
#   `schlusssatz` exists for the program (source -> model -> emitted C; `zaehle-kette.py
#   --lean` measures whether it is CLOSED), `chain=none` otherwise: then "machine G is the
#   meaning of the emitted C" is an assumption of the reading for this program.
# UNCERTIFIED <program> <code> <message>
#   The exporter refuses the program (its FIRST refusal, code and message): no `Einheit`, so
#   no Lean judgement at all. A green build says NOTHING about this program; the goal theorem
#   reaches it only by a hand-written term (`Korpus07.lean`, `Korpus125.lean`).
UNCERTIFIED	beispiele/01-tabelle.gab	LG002	field marke is wrapping
UNCERTIFIED	beispiele/02-geraet.gab	LG001	type QueuePhase has no `Ty` form, because a mark is a RESOURCE and not a value: an `order { … }` names the STUFEN of a mark: `D.stufen m` is the number of them, a mark stands at `Res.marke m s`, and `Stmt.advances` moves it from `s` to `s + 1`. This exporter writes `Marke := Empty`, builds no `konsumiert`/`produziert` and exports neither `advances` nor `retires`, so a mark that travelled would travel as nothing
UNCERTIFIED	beispiele/03-format.gab	LG001	format Elf64Kopf has no G form: a `format` is a `Tab` with `count 1` whose `where` clauses are `Block.pruefung` (Syntax.lean §9); this exporter builds no such table
UNCERTIFIED	beispiele/04-schleifen.gab	LG001	type Angemeldet has no `Ty` form, because a mark is a RESOURCE and not a value: a `linear` mark is `D.Marke`, held in `Λ` as `Res.marke m s` and moved by `Signatur.konsumiert`/`produziert`, `Stmt.advances` and `Stmt.retires`. This exporter writes `Marke := Empty`, builds no `konsumiert`/`produziert` and exports neither `advances` nor `retires`, so a mark that travelled would travel as nothing
UNCERTIFIED	beispiele/05-nebenlaeufigkeit.gab	LG001	atomic FARBE_FERTIG has no G form: an `atomic` is a `Glob` with `atomar = true` and a `nutzlast`, and its accesses are `Stmt.publish`/`Block.awaits`/`Block.exchange`; this exporter writes `atomar := fun _ => false` and exports none of the three
UNCERTIFIED	beispiele/06-annahmen.gab	LG001	assume mmu_folgt_ihrem_modell has no G form: a named assumption is `D.Annahme`, which the specification consumes only at `Stmt.forever` and `Stmt.retires`; this exporter builds no `Annahme` and exports neither statement
UNCERTIFIED	beispiele/07-eintritt-und-boot.gab	LG001	type BootPhase has no `Ty` form, because a mark is a RESOURCE and not a value: a `linear ghost` mark is `D.Marke` with `stufen m = 1`: it is held in `Λ` as `Res.marke m 0`, consumed through `Signatur.konsumiert` and retired by `Stmt.retires`; `ghost` itself is the carrier flag `D.geist`. This exporter writes `Marke := Empty`, builds no `konsumiert`/`produziert` and exports neither `advances` nor `retires`, so a mark that travelled would travel as nothing

UNCERTIFIED	beispiele/21-verbundwert.gab	LG002	the result of fertig is the record Completion, and a record has NO `Ty`: `Typen.lean` §1 is `int`, `bool`, `opt`, `sum`, `grund`, `never`, `fl`, `fnptr`, `ptr` -- there is no product. A record travels as a CARRIER (a `Tab` with `count 1`, reached through a pointer, `Syntax.lean` §1/§9), and that is built; it does NOT travel as a value, so a result, a parameter or a `let` of record type has no form at all. Passing a `ptr<normal, r> Completion` has one
